dictionary.title: Home Assistant
dictionary.description: Complete smart home hub: devices, automations, rooms, energy consumption and voice Assist.
dictionary.assist_subtitle: Query native Assist with your custom sentences (/config/custom_sentences) and YAML packages
dictionary.assist_prompt_placeholder: E.g. «how much power is the house drawing?», «turn on living room»…
dictionary.quick_test_energy: How much power is the whole house drawing?
dictionary.conn_intro: Enter one or more Home Assistant addresses and the access token. Nuxiva tries the addresses in order and uses the first that answers, so it keeps working both at home and away.
dictionary.conn_addresses_hint: Without a port I use 8123. You can type just the IP (192.168.1.20), a name (homeassistant.local) or a full address with https://. Up to 6.
dictionary.conn_token_saved: Token already saved: leave empty to keep it
dictionary.conn_token_how: How do I get the token?
dictionary.conn_step_1: Open Home Assistant in the browser and sign in.
dictionary.conn_step_2: Click your name at the bottom left to open your Profile.
dictionary.conn_step_3: Go to the «Security» tab and scroll to «Long-lived access tokens».
dictionary.conn_step_4: Press «Create token», name it (e.g. Nuxiva), copy the token (it is shown only once) and paste it here.
dictionary.conn_verify_hint: Turn it off only if you use https with a self-signed certificate on your network.
dictionary.conn_test_ok: REST API reachable. Save to start the WebSocket connection and registry sync; this test does not verify their completion.
dictionary.conn_test_none: No address answered: check the messages below.
dictionary.conn_saved: Saved: Nuxiva reconnects with the new settings.
dictionary.conn_state_not_home_assistant: Does not look like Home Assistant
dictionary.conn_banner_missing: Home Assistant is not connected yet: enter address and token.
dictionary.conn_banner_auth: Home Assistant rejected the token: create a new one and save it.
